an6.82:1.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye
an6.82:1.3: musāvādī hoti pisuṇāvāco hoti pharusāvāco hoti samphappalāpī hoti luddho ca pagabbho ca
an6.82:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an6.82:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
an6.82:2.3: musāvādā paṭivirato hoti pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti aluddho ca appagabbho ca
an6.82:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti. 83
